actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (inflammatory/IL6-JAK-STAT3 up-regulation, metabolic down-regulation, PBRM1 depletion, chr14q/chr6p/CDKN2A losses) with positive cross-modal silhouettes and boundary separation from C0002, no set-level technical confounder, and no stage/grade echo. Silhouettes are near zero and the global site association is a caveat, so uncertainty remains, but no available request could resolve this and the candidate is defensible for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent reciprocal multi-modality profile (metabolic up-regulation, inflammatory down-regulation, PBRM1/ATM enrichment, fewer recurrent losses) with positive cross-modal silhouettes and boundary separation from C0001, no set-level technical confounder, and no stage/grade echo. Weak separation and the global site association leave uncertainty, but no available request could resolve it and the candidate is defensible for downstream validation.
